items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: So the same, George Hooker, he came over... He come down there and, you know, I got some pieces... we just run over it... and I played it and I played it pretty good

ctx.x: They ain't know nothing. I had to teach them. The fella come in the X7 band. He was, I used to think he was a great man. The fella in the Georgia Hooker. He used to play trumpet in the band over here, the Pacific band. I thought he was a big shot. He had them on baritone and come over there and had to show them how to divide the music. Well, I was surprised. Then they hired me from the country to play with a, Sonny Henry recommended me to a band, they call it the Terramir band, down in Ninth Wall. They come up…
Who was the leader, the boss of the whole band?
